checks.text: With no entries the page shows the heading "Expense Tracker", the text "No transactions yet", and the summary line "Total spent: $0.00".

Filling the field labelled "Description" with "Groceries", the MoneyInput labelled "Amount" with "45.50", choosing "Food" in the select labelled "Category", and clicking the button "Add transaction" adds a row in the ledger table containing "Groceries", "Food", and "-$45.50"; the summary shows "Total spent: $45.50" and "No transactions yet" is gone.
After adding a second transaction with Description "Coffee", Amount "4.25", Category "Food", the ledger table shows two rows and the summary shows "Total spent: $49.75".
Clicking "Add transaction" with an empty Description, or with an Amount that is empty or 0, adds no row and shows the message "Enter a description and an amount greater than 0".

Every row in the ledger table has a button named "Delete <description>". With the transactions Groceries 45.50 and Coffee 4.25, clicking "Delete Coffee" removes that row and the summary shows "Total spent: $45.50".
Clicking the tab labelled "Budgets" shows a table with a row for "Food" displaying "Budget: $0.00" and "Spent: $45.50"; clicking the tab labelled "Ledger" returns to the transaction list.

In the Budgets tab, filling the field labelled "Budget" in the Food row with "100" and clicking "Save budget" changes that row to "Budget: $100.00" and "Spent: $45.50", and the status text shows "Under budget".
Clicking the button "Export CSV" copies a CSV string to the clipboard that begins with "date,description,category,amount" and contains a line "2024-01-15,Groceries,Food,-4550".
Reload keeps the transaction with Description "Groceries" and Amount "-$45.50" in the ledger table, and the summary line "Total spent: $45.50".
